title: I had a weird one last night where I had to save mall world
content: In my dream I was wandering around what looked like Manhattan and went into an enormous modernistic mall comprised of silver, metal and glass. It was really shiny. I was wandering around because the stores inside were really interesting. There was another woman looking around who I said hello to since I seem to be as friendly in mall world as I am normally. Suddenly the entire mall was teeming with zombies eagerly chasing me and another younger woman who I was trying to help. This zombie situation is new since I usually just have mall dreams where I’m discovering new things and everything is normally just kind of fascinating. The dream went further and I kept finding random swords that were beautiful and visibly blazing with energy to eradicate the zombies. Apparently I’m pretty good with zombie eradication in my dreams. I eventually made my way out of the mall and fought my way into a cemetery where I found a crypt that had a crystal that quelled the zombie invasion. I woke up completely exhausted. Has anyone ever dreamt about having to protect mall world? This was new to me and extremely vivid and quite graphic.
